root_cause.text: In the mediatek vcodec encoder driver, the release path (fops_vcodec_release) frees the context (ctx) without first cancelling or synchronizing with the workqueue handler (mtk_venc_worker) that may still be accessing ctx after the m2m job completes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds cancel_work_sync(&ctx->encode_work) before kfree(ctx). The CVE description states: "The fops_vcodec_release() function frees the context structure (ctx) without first cancelling any pending or running work in ctx->encode_work. This creates a race window where the workqueue handler (mtk_venc_worker) may still be accessing the context memory after it has been freed." KASAN confirmed use-after-free in mtk_venc_worker at freed memory.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add cancel_work_sync() to prevent use-after-free in MediaTek video encoder release path by ensuring pending encode work is cancelled before freeing the context.
intent_record.what: Added cancel_work_sync(&ctx->encode_work) call with a comment explaining the need to cancel any pending encode work before freeing the context, placed between v4l2_ctrl_handler_free and the spin_lock.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any pending work scheduled on the encode workqueue is completed or cancelled synchronously before the context is freed, preventing a use-after-free condition where the workqueue handler might access ctx after it has been freed.

grouping_result.intent: Add cancel_work_sync() to prevent use-after-free in MediaTek video encoder release path by ensuring pending encode work is cancelled before freeing the context.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the root cause by adding cancel_work_sync() to prevent a use-after-free scenario where the workqueue handler may still access the context after it is freed in the release path.

candidates.rationale: This line exits the V4L2 file handle, which is part of freeing the context. Without canceling the pending work, the worker may still be accessing ctx->fh, leading to use-after-free.
This line frees the control handler associated with the context. If the workqueue handler is still using ctx->ctrl_hdl, it will result in use-after-free.

This line removes the context from the device's list. Concurrent access by the workqueue handler to traverse the list or to access ctx via the list entry can cause a use-after-free or list corruption.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement exits the V4L2 file handle, but if the workqueue handler (mtk_venc_worker) is still executing and accessing ctx->fh, a use-after-free occurs because ctx is freed afterwards without cancelling the work first.
This statement frees the control handler, but if the workqueue handler is still using ctx->ctrl_hdl concurrently, it results in use-after-free.
This statement removes the context from the device's list. The workqueue handler might still be traversing the list or accessing ctx via the list entry, leading to use-after-free or list corruption.
